description: List the papers and abstracts submitted to one of the organization's events, with each submission's review status and track. Use it to answer 'how many submissions do we have', 'what has been accepted', or to summarize a track. Draft and withdrawn submissions are excluded. Attendee registrations are NOT submissions — use list_registrations for those. Requires the organization API key to be configured; without one this returns an error telling the user where to create a key.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

name: list_submissions
title: List an event's submissions
